populationExpansion.selection: Five largest California incorporated cities missing after PR 83. Include Census places sharing or nearly sharing their boundaries (0.002-degree tolerance), plus the three nearest incorporated-city representative points within 40 km. Original coverage is retained. Nearby regions are selected places, not entire counties.

metadata.method: Census incorporated places and census-designated places with a positive-area intersection with a selected district. Split-place membership does not establish the district of an individual address. Explicitly requested cities are included in full even outside those districts. County remainders are covered through county profiles. Boundaries are simplified for display.
